name: application-weather-forecast-row
title: Weather Forecast Row
description: 7-day forecast strip with per-day condition icon, high/low temperatures, and precipitation percentage — distinct from weather-widget, which is a current-conditions tile with an hourly strip and no multi-day forecast or precipitation data.
useWhen: Showing a week-ahead weather outlook rather than current conditions.
You need precipitation likelihood alongside each day's high/low.
A compact horizontal strip fits better than a full weather widget card.
avoidWhen: You need current conditions with an hourly breakdown — use weather-widget instead.
You only need a single day's forecast — a simpler stat display is sufficient.
Precipitation data isn't available — omit that row rather than showing a placeholder 0%.
responsiveBehavior: Each day column shares equal width via flex-1 within the strip; on narrow viewports the consuming page should wrap this in a horizontally scrollable container.
accessibility: Condition icons are aria-hidden since the high/low and precipitation text already convey the day's forecast.
High and low temperatures use distinct font weights (semibold vs regular) so they're distinguishable without relying on position alone.
Precipitation percentage is always shown as text, not implied only by icon choice.

variants.title: Weather forecast row
variants.description: A 7-day forecast mixing sun, cloud, and rain days with varying precipitation percentages and hi/lo temperatures, on a light surface.
accessibility: Rain days show meaningfully higher precipitation percentages (60-80%) than sun days (0%), keeping the icon and number internally consistent.

variants.title: Weather forecast row (Dark)
variants.description: The same 7-day forecast, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Icon and text colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
